_meta.description: Reliability and risk equations consumed by ConstraintMapper to emit SysML constraint def blocks

constraints.name: RiskPriorityNumber
constraints.description: FMEA Risk Priority Number: product of Severity, Occurrence, and Detection ratings (MIL-STD-1629A)

parameters.name: rpn
parameters.description: Risk Priority Number — higher values indicate higher risk

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Severity of failure effect on system or user (AIAG scale)

parameters.name: occurrence
parameters.description: Likelihood of failure cause occurring during design life

parameters.name: detection
parameters.description: Likelihood that existing controls will detect the failure before it reaches the customer

constraints.verification_note: RPN alone is not sufficient for safety-critical assessment; use in conjunction with STPA hazard severity

constraints.name: ParallelRedundancyFailureRate
constraints.description: System failure rate for two pumps in active parallel redundancy (both must fail for system failure). Based on exponential reliability model assuming constant failure rates.

parameters.name: lambda_sys
parameters.description: Combined system failure rate with parallel redundancy

parameters.name: lambda_B
parameters.description: Pump B failure rate (exponential model); assumed equal to lambda_A for identical pumps

constraints.standard: IEC 61508-6 Table B.5 — Redundancy architectures; MIL-HDBK-217F
constraints.verification_note: Valid for exponential lifetime distribution only; use Weibull for wear-out phases > 8000 run hours

constraints.name: NPSHMarginCheck
constraints.description: Cavitation avoidance constraint: available NPSH must exceed required NPSH by the design margin

parameters.name: npsh_available
parameters.description: Net Positive Suction Head available from system geometry and fluid conditions

parameters.name: npsh_required
parameters.description: NPSH required by pump at rated flow, per vendor curve

parameters.name: npsh_margin
parameters.description: Design margin added to account for transient conditions (typically 1.0 m per Hydraulic Institute)

constraints.standard: Hydraulic Institute Standards; ISO 9906 — Rotodynamic pumps
